question: Identify the antonym of "Malice":
solution:
The correct answer is: **Kindness**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Malice"** refers to the intention or desire to do harm or cause suffering to someone. (द्वेष)
 
 
• **Example:** His malice toward his rival was evident in the way he spoke about him.
 
 
• **"Kindness"**, on the other hand, means the quality of being generous, considerate, and caring toward others. (दया)
 
 
• **Example:** Her kindness toward the homeless man restored his faith in humanity.
 
 
• Since "Kindness" is the opposite of "Malice," it is the correct answer.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Kindness**.

---

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Cruelty** (क्रूरता): Behavior that causes pain and suffering to others.
 
 
• **Example:** The cruelty of the dictator was evident in his harsh policies.
 
 

 
• **Hatred** (घृणा): Intense dislike or ill will toward someone or something.
 
 
• **Example:** The long-standing hatred between the two families led to several conflicts.
 
 

 
• **Spite** (द्वेष): A desire to hurt, annoy, or offend someone.
 
 
• **Example:** He spread false rumors about her out of spite.
